title: open-charts chart spec, version 1
description: One chart. Unversioned specs (v0) have the same shape and are upgraded by migrate(). Semantic rules the schema cannot express (values per series = number of categories, unique series names, cagr.from < cagr.to, each option only on the chart types its description lists, tuple length per scatter / bubble, gantt end after start) are enforced by validateSpec().

categories.description: Category labels. Years ("2024", "FY24", "2025E"), quarters ("Q1 2023"), halves ("H1 2023"), months ("Jan 2023", "2023-01") and ISO dates are read as dates for CAGR.

style.description: Style overrides for this chart, over the deck's style.

overrides.description: Per-element formatting: an element's role ("label:value:s1:c2") or a selector with "*" ("label:value:s1:*", "bar:*:c2", "label:category:*") to its style. Exact roles win over series / category selectors, which win over kind selectors. Which properties an element takes depends on its kind (validateSpec; DATA-FORMAT.md Overrides). An index past the data is a layout warning, not an error.

elementColor.description: A hex colour, a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or one with a tint / shade: "accent1-lighter40", "accent1-darker25" (0-100).

content.description: Labels: ordered fields, joined with separator.

separator.description: Labels: text between fields (default one space).

font.description: Text: font name, or +mj-lt / +mn-lt (theme heading / body font).

rotate.description: Text direction: -90 (90 degrees left), 0, 90 (90 degrees right).

pattern.description: Segments: OOXML preset pattern in the fill colour on the theme background, or none.

pin.description: Labels: placed by hand; centre as fractions of the frame, kept until reset.

detach.description: Labels: converted to plain text; content holds the static text.

color.description: A hex colour, or a theme colour that follows the presentation's theme: accent1-accent6, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, or the slide-mapped tx1, bg1, tx2, bg2.

theme.description: Hex colour of each theme slot, for previews, the theme of decks the CLI writes and label contrast. Default: the open-charts theme.

numbers.description: Number defaults for every chart; a chart's own options win.

elements.description: Default element styles: role or selector to an element style, the overrides vocabulary. A chart's own overrides win, property by property; pin and detach are per element only.

diffMode.description: relative: change in percent from "from" to "to" (→); absolute: the signed difference (↔); reverse: change in percent from "to" to "from" (←).

series.description: Series index: the top of its segment / its point. Omitted: the column total (stacked and 100% only).

anyOf.description: Waterfall only: this category is a computed total.
Scatter: [x, y]; bubble: [x, y, size]. The category is the point's label.
Gantt: a date ("2026-03-15", "Mar 2026", "Q2 2026"). Table: text shown as is.

as.description: Combination chart: draw this series as a line over the columns.

hidden.description: Leave this row out of the chart; its data stays in the spec. Not on the Start/End rows of a Gantt chart or the width row of a Mekko XY chart; at least one series stays visible.

anyOf.description: Suffix without a space, e.g. "m" or "%".

totals.description: Chart types: stacked, percent, mekko, area, doughnut, combo, mekkoxy.

difference.description: Chart types: stacked, percent. Total difference arrow between two column totals; mode default "absolute".

valueAxis.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, combo, mekkoxy.

decimals.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, pie, doughnut, combo, mekkoxy, scatter, bubble, table.

unit.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, pie, doughnut, combo, mekkoxy, scatter, bubble, table.

format.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, pie, doughnut, combo, mekkoxy, scatter, bubble, table. Excel number format, e.g. "#,##0.0", "$#,##0", "0%", "#,##0;(#,##0)".

locale.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, pie, doughnut, combo, mekkoxy, scatter, bubble, table, gantt.

scale.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, pie, doughnut, combo, mekkoxy, scatter, bubble, table.

direction.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, combo. Which way the chart grows: up (columns, default), down (hanging columns), right (bars; a line becomes a profile), left (bars from the right). Line and area charts: up, left or right.

gap.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, combo.

seriesLabels.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, mekko, line, area, area100, pie, doughnut, combo, mekkoxy, scatter, bubble, gantt.

step.description: Chart types: line. Step (ortho) line, horizontal then vertical.

percentData.description: Chart types: percent. Values are already percentages; columns keep their own totals on the % axis.

combo.description: Chart types: combo. How the column series are drawn.

sort.description: Chart types: mekkoxy. Category order (by height for ascending / descending).

axisTitles.description: Chart types: scatter, bubble. Axis titles.

shades.description: Chart types: gantt. Shaded periods across every row.

brackets.description: Chart types: gantt. Brackets labelling periods of time (phases), under the rows.

today.description: Chart types: gantt. Date of a "today" line through every row.

sizeLegend.description: Chart types: bubble. Size legend; a string adds a caption.

labelContent.description: Chart types: pie, doughnut. Slice labels show shares (default), absolute values, or both.

scaleGroup.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, waterfall, line, area, combo. Same-scale group: charts on one slide with the same name draw values at one scale.

axisMax.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, waterfall, line, area, combo. Top of the value axis: it reaches at least this value (headroom above the data); a value below the data's top is ignored.

levelArrows.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, line. Level difference arrows between two segment tops / points or a value line; mode default "relative".

valueLines.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, line. Horizontal reference lines; "mean" = the mean of the column totals (clustered: of the bars).

label.description: Label text; {value} is replaced by the formatted value.

percentIndicator.description: Chart types: percent. The 100% indicator beside the chart.

percentBase.description: Chart types: percent. The datasheet's 100%= row: one base per category, null = the column's sum.

categoryGaps.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, combo. One extra category slot after each listed category (repeat for more).

categoryBreaks.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered, percent, waterfall, combo. A category axis break symbol after each listed category.

axisBreak.description: Chart types: stacked, clustered. The value range from–to is compressed; bars spanning it show the break.

secondaryAxis.description: Chart types: combo. Indices of line series drawn against a second value axis on the right.
